My beautiful labubuuu,

If I could put all the little things I love about you into the sky, every night would be brighter. I love your smile, your energy, your softness, your strength and all the little details that make you you

I hope life gives you reasons to laugh until your cheeks hurt, moments that make your heart feel full and people who remind you how precious you are. I hope you see yourself through my eyes, even for a second, because then you would understand why I think you are such a beautiful part of my world

Thank you for the memories, the laughter, the affection and the little moments that have become special simply because I shared them with you. If I could choose one person to find in every lifetime, it would always be you ♡

Always yours
